SDK_POST_INSTALL_COMMAND_task-populate-sdk-ext="	printf \"\nExtracting buildtools...\n\" \
	cd \$target_sdk_dir \
	env_setup_script=\"\$target_sdk_dir/environment-setup-cortexa7t2hf-neon-vfpv4-poky-linux-gnueabi\" \
        if [ -n \"\${SDK_BUILDTOOLS_INSTALLER}\" ]; then \
		printf \"buildtools\ny\" | ./\${SDK_BUILDTOOLS_INSTALLER} > buildtools.log || { printf 'ERROR: buildtools installation failed:\n' ; cat buildtools.log ; echo \"printf 'ERROR: this SDK was not fully installed and needs reinstalling\n'\" >> \$env_setup_script ; exit 1 ; } \
 \
		# Delete the buildtools tar file since it won't be used again \
		rm -f ./\${SDK_BUILDTOOLS_INSTALLER} \
		# We don't need the log either since it succeeded \
		rm -f buildtools.log \
 \
		# Make sure when the user sets up the environment, they also get \
		# the buildtools-tarball tools in their path. \
		echo \". \$target_sdk_dir/buildtools/environment-setup*\" >> \$env_setup_script \
	fi \
 \
	# Allow bitbake environment setup to be ran as part of this sdk. \
	echo \"export OE_SKIP_SDK_CHECK=1\" >> \$env_setup_script \
	# Work around runqemu not knowing how to get this information within the eSDK \
	echo \"export DEPLOY_DIR_IMAGE=\$target_sdk_dir/tmp/deploy/images/stm32mp1\" >> \$env_setup_script \
 \
	# A bit of another hack, but we need this in the path only for devtool \
	# so put it at the end of \$PATH. \
	echo \"export PATH=\$target_sdk_dir/sysroots/x86_64-pokysdk-linux/usr/bin:\\$PATH\" >> \$env_setup_script \
 \
	echo \"printf 'SDK environment now set up; additionally you may now run devtool to perform development tasks.\nRun devtool --help for further details.\n'\" >> \$env_setup_script \
 \
	# Warn if trying to use external bitbake and the ext SDK together \
	echo \"(which bitbake > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'WARNING: attempting to use the extensible SDK in an environment set up to run bitbake - this may lead to unexpected results. Please source this script in a new shell session instead.') || true\" >> \$env_setup_script \
 \
	if [ \"\$prepare_buildsystem\" != \"no\" -a -n \"\${SDK_BUILDTOOLS_INSTALLER}\" ]; then \
		printf \"Preparing build system...\n\" \
		# dash which is /bin/sh on Ubuntu will not preserve the \
		# current working directory when first ran, nor will it set \$1 when \
		# sourcing a script. That is why this has to look so ugly. \
		LOGFILE=\"\$target_sdk_dir/preparing_build_system.log\" \
		sh -c \". buildtools/environment-setup* > \$LOGFILE && cd \$target_sdk_dir/`dirname \${oe_init_build_env_path}` && set \$target_sdk_dir && . \$target_sdk_dir/\${oe_init_build_env_path} \$target_sdk_dir >> \$LOGFILE && python3 \$target_sdk_dir/ext-sdk-prepare.py \$LOGFILE ''\" || { echo \"printf 'ERROR: this SDK was not fully installed and needs reinstalling\n'\" >> \$env_setup_script ; exit 1 ; } \
	fi \
	if [ -e \$target_sdk_dir/ext-sdk-prepare.py ]; then \
		rm \$target_sdk_dir/ext-sdk-prepare.py \
	fi \
	echo done \
"

SDK_PRE_INSTALL_COMMAND_task-populate-sdk-ext="	# Since bitbake won't run as root it doesn't make sense to try and install \
	# the extensible sdk as root. \
	if [ \"`id -u`\" = \"0\" ]; then \
		echo \"ERROR: The extensible sdk cannot be installed as root.\" \
		exit 1 \
	fi \
	if ! command -v locale > /dev/null; then \
		echo \"ERROR: The installer requires the locale command, please install it first\" \
		exit 1 \
	fi \
        # Check setting of LC_ALL set above \
	canonicalised_locale=`echo \$LC_ALL | sed 's/UTF-8/utf8/'` \
	if ! locale -a | grep -q \$canonicalised_locale ; then \
		echo \"ERROR: the installer requires the \$LC_ALL locale to be installed (but not selected), please install it first\" \
		exit 1 \
	fi \
	# The relocation script used by buildtools installer requires python \
	if ! command -v python3 > /dev/null; then \
		echo \"ERROR: The installer requires python3, please install it first\" \
		exit 1 \
	fi \
	missing_utils=\"\" \
	for util in \${SDK_REQUIRED_UTILITIES}; do \
		if ! command -v \$util > /dev/null; then \
			missing_utils=\"\$missing_utils \$util\" \
		fi \
	done \
	if [ -n \"\$missing_utils\" ] ; then \
		echo \"ERROR: the SDK requires the following missing utilities, please install them: \$missing_utils\" \
		exit 1 \
	fi \
	SDK_EXTENSIBLE=\"1\" \
	if [ \"\$publish\" = \"1\" ] && [ \"full\" = \"minimal\" ] ; then \
		EXTRA_TAR_OPTIONS=\"\$EXTRA_TAR_OPTIONS --exclude=sstate-cache\" \
	fi \
"

IMAGE_CMD_btrfs() {
	size=${ROOTFS_SIZE}
	if [ ${size} -lt 16384 ] ; then
		size=16384
		bbwarn "Rootfs size is too small for BTRFS. Filesystem will be extended to ${size}K"
	fi
	dd if=/dev/zero of=/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.rootfs.btrfs seek=${size} count=0 bs=1024
	mkfs.btrfs  -r /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.rootfs.btrfs
}

IMAGE_CMD_cpio() {
	(cd /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs && find . | sort | cpio --reproducible -o -H newc >/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.rootfs.cpio)
	# We only need the /init symlink if we're building the real
	# image. The -dbg image doesn't need it! By being clever
	# about this we also avoid 'touch' below failing, as it
	# might be trying to touch /sbin/init on the host since both
	# the normal and the -dbg image share the same WORKDIR
	if [ "${IMAGE_BUILDING_DEBUGFS}" != "true" ]; then
		if [ ! -L /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/init ] && [ ! -e /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/init ]; then
			if [ -L /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/sbin/init ] || [ -e /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/sbin/init ]; then
				ln -sf /sbin/init /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/cpio_append/init
			else
				touch /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/cpio_append/init
			fi
			(cd  /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/cpio_append && echo ./init | cpio -oA -H newc -F /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.rootfs.cpio)
		fi
	fi
}

IMAGE_CMD_f2fs() {
        # We need to add additional smarts here form devices smaller than 1.5G
        # Need to scale appropriately between 40M -> 1.5G as the "overprovision
        # ratio" goes down as the device gets bigger (70% -> 4.5%), below about
        # 500M the standard IMAGE_OVERHEAD_FACTOR does not work, so add additional
        # space here when under 500M
	size=${ROOTFS_SIZE}
	if [ ${size} -lt 524288 ] ; then
		size=524288
		bbwarn "Rootfs size is too small for F2FS. Filesystem will be extended to ${size}K"
	fi
	dd if=/dev/zero of=/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.rootfs.f2fs seek=${size} count=0 bs=1024
	mkfs.f2fs  /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.rootfs.f2fs
	sload.f2fs -f /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.rootfs.f2fs
}

IMAGE_CMD_multiubi() {
	# Split MKUBIFS_ARGS_<name> and UBINIZE_ARGS_<name>
	for name in  nand_4_256; do
		eval local mkubifs_args=\"\$MKUBIFS_ARGS_${name}\"
		eval local ubinize_args=\"\$UBINIZE_ARGS_${name}\"

		multiubi_mkfs "${mkubifs_args}" "${ubinize_args}" "${name}"
	done
}

IMAGE_CMD_ubi() {
	multiubi_mkfs "${MKUBIFS_ARGS}" "${UBINIZE_ARGS}"
}

IMAGE_CMD_wic() {
	out="/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229"
	build_wic="/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/build-wic"
	tmp_wic="/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/tmp-wic"
	wks=""
	if [ -e "$tmp_wic" ]; then
		# Ensure we don't have any junk leftover from a previously interrupted
		# do_image_wic execution
		rm -rf "$tmp_wic"
	fi
	if [ -z "$wks" ]; then
		bbfatal "No kickstart files from WKS_FILES were found: custom-image.stm32mp1.wks custom-image.wks. Please set WKS_FILE or WKS_FILES appropriately."
	fi
	BUILDDIR="/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1" PSEUDO_UNLOAD=1 wic create "$wks" --vars "/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/sysroots/stm32mp1/imgdata/" -e "custom-image" -o "$build_wic/" -w "$tmp_wic" 
	mv "$build_wic/$(basename "${wks%.wks}")"*.direct "$out.rootfs.wic"
}

base_do_compile() {
	if [ -e Makefile -o -e makefile -o -e GNUmakefile ]; then
		oe_runmake || die "make failed"
	else
		bbnote "nothing to compile"
	fi
}

base_do_configure() {
	if [ -n "/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/configure.sstate" -a -e "/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/configure.sstate" ]; then
		if [ "`cat /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/configure.sstate`" != "${BB_TASKHASH}" ]; then
			cd /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/custom-image-1.0
			if [ "0" != "1" -a \( -e Makefile -o -e makefile -o -e GNUmakefile \) ]; then
				oe_runmake clean
			fi
			# -ignore_readdir_race does not work correctly with -delete;
			# use xargs to avoid spurious build failures
			find /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/custom-image-1.0 -ignore_readdir_race -name \*.la -type f -print0 | xargs -0 rm -f
		fi
	fi
	if [ -n "/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/configure.sstate" ]; then
		mkdir -p `dirname /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/configure.sstate`
		echo ${BB_TASKHASH} > /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/configure.sstate
	fi
}

bbdebug() {
	USAGE='Usage: bbdebug [123] "message"'
	if [ $# -lt 2 ]; then
		bbfatal "$USAGE"
	fi

	# Strip off the debug level and ensure it is an integer
	DBGLVL=$1; shift
	NONDIGITS=$(echo "$DBGLVL" | tr -d "[:digit:]")
	if [ "$NONDIGITS" ]; then
		bbfatal "$USAGE"
	fi

	# All debug output is printed to the logs
	if [ -p /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/temp/fifo.2421 ] ; then
		printf "%b\0" "bbdebug $DBGLVL $*" > /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/temp/fifo.2421
	else
		echo "DEBUG: $*"
	fi
}

create_cmdline_wrapper() {
	# Create a wrapper script where commandline options are needed
	#
	# These are useful to work around relocation issues, by passing extra options
	# to a program
	#
	# Usage: create_cmdline_wrapper FILENAME <extra-options>

	cmd=$1
	shift

	echo "Generating wrapper script for $cmd"

	mv $cmd $cmd.real
	cmdname=`basename $cmd`
	dirname=`dirname $cmd`
	cmdoptions=$@
	if [ "" != "" ]; then
		relpath=`python3 -c "import os; print(os.path.relpath('/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/image', '$dirname'))"`
		cmdoptions=`echo $@ | sed -e "s::\\$realdir/$relpath:g"`
	fi
	cat <<END >$cmd
#!/bin/bash
realpath=\`readlink -fn \$0\`
realdir=\`dirname \$realpath\`
exec -a \$realdir/$cmdname \$realdir/$cmdname.real $cmdoptions "\$@"
END
	chmod +x $cmd
}

create_merged_usr_symlinks() {
    root="$1"
    install -d $root/bin $root/sbin $root/lib
    lnr $root/bin $root/bin
    lnr $root/sbin $root/sbin
    lnr $root/lib $root/lib

    if [ "/lib" != "/lib" ]; then
       install -d $root/lib
       lnr $root/lib $root/lib
    fi

    # create base links for multilibs
    multi_libdirs=""
    for d in $multi_libdirs; do
        install -d $root/usr/$d
        lnr $root/usr/$d $root/$d
    done
}

create_merged_usr_symlinks_rootfs() {
    create_merged_usr_symlinks /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs
}

create_merged_usr_symlinks_sdk() {

}

create_wrapper() {
	# Create a wrapper script where extra environment variables are needed
	#
	# These are useful to work around relocation issues, by setting environment
	# variables which point to paths in the filesystem.
	#
	# Usage: create_wrapper FILENAME [[VAR=VALUE]..]

	cmd=$1
	shift

	echo "Generating wrapper script for $cmd"

	mv $cmd $cmd.real
	cmdname=`basename $cmd`
	dirname=`dirname $cmd`
	exportstring=$@
	if [ "" != "" ]; then
		relpath=`python3 -c "import os; print(os.path.relpath('/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/image', '$dirname'))"`
		exportstring=`echo $@ | sed -e "s::\\$realdir/$relpath:g"`
	fi
	cat <<END >$cmd
#!/bin/bash
realpath=\`readlink -fn \$0\`
realdir=\`dirname \$realpath\`
export $exportstring
exec -a "\$0" \$realdir/$cmdname.real "\$@"
END
	chmod +x $cmd
}

	bbfatal_log "$*"

do_image_stmultiubi() {
	    . /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/temp/stmultiubi_environment

    # Split MKUBIFS_ARGS_<name> and UBINIZE_ARGS_<name>
    for name in  nand_4_256; do
        eval local mkubifs_args=\"\$MKUBIFS_ARGS_${name}\"
        eval local ubinize_args=\"\$UBINIZE_ARGS_${name}\"
        multiubi_mkfs "${mkubifs_args}" "${ubinize_args}" "${name}"

        cd /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete
        if [ -e ubinize_${name}-custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.cfg ]; then
            # Set correct name for cfg file to allow automatic cleanup
            mv ubinize_${name}-custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.cfg custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229_${name}.ubinize.cfg.ubi
            # Create symlinks
            ln -sf custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229_${name}.ubinize.cfg.ubi custom-image-stm32mp1_${name}.ubinize.cfg.ubi
        fi
        cd -
    done

	cd /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete
}

    then
        # link requested:
        # libEGL.so.1 -> /vendor/lib/libEGL.so
        if [ ! -L /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/usr/lib/libEGL.so.1 ];

            ln -s $LINK /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/usr/lib/libEGL.so.1
        fi
        # link requested:
        # libgbm.so.1 -> /vendor/lib/libgbm.so
        if [ ! -L /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/usr/lib/libgbm.so.1 ];
        then
            LINK=$(readlink /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/usr/lib/libgbm.so)
            ln -s $LINK /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/usr/lib/libgbm.so.1
        fi
        # link requested:
        # libGLESv2.so.2 -> /vendor/lib/libGLESv2.so
        if [ ! -L /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/usr/lib/libGLESv2.so.2 ];
        then
            LINK=$(readlink /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/usr/lib/libGLESv2.so)
            ln -s $LINK /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/usr/lib/libGLESv2.so.2
        fi
    fi

install_tools() {
	install -d /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/sdk/image//usr/local/oe-sdk-hardcoded-buildpath/sysroots/x86_64-pokysdk-linux/usr/bin
	scripts="devtool recipetool oe-find-native-sysroot runqemu* wic"
	for script in $scripts; do
		for scriptfn in `find /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/sdk/image//usr/local/oe-sdk-hardcoded-buildpath/${scriptrelpath} -maxdepth 1 -executable -name "$script"`; do

			test -e ${targetscriptfn} || lnr ${scriptfn} ${targetscriptfn}
		done
	done
	# We can't use the same method as above because files in the sysroot won't exist at this point
	# (they get populated from sstate on installation)
	unfsd_path="/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/sdk/image//usr/local/oe-sdk-hardcoded-buildpath/sysroots/x86_64-pokysdk-linux/usr/bin/unfsd"
	if [ "1" = "1" -a ! -e $unfsd_path ] ; then
		binrelpath=work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/recipe-sysroot-native/usr/bin
		lnr /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/sdk/image//usr/local/oe-sdk-hardcoded-buildpath/tmp/$binrelpath/unfsd $unfsd_path
	fi
	touch /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/sdk/image//usr/local/oe-sdk-hardcoded-buildpath/.devtoolbase

	# find latest buildtools-tarball and install it
	if [ -n "${SDK_BUILDTOOLS_INSTALLER}" ]; then
		install /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/deploy/sdk/${SDK_BUILDTOOLS_INSTALLER} /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/sdk/image//usr/local/oe-sdk-hardcoded-buildpath
	fi

	install -m 0644 /home/regan/Projects/yocto/poky/meta/files/ext-sdk-prepare.py /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/sdk/image//usr/local/oe-sdk-hardcoded-buildpath
}

mklibs_optimize_image() {
	for img in ${MKLIBS_OPTIMIZED_IMAGES}
	do
		if [ "${img}" = "custom-image" ] || [ "${img}" = "all" ]
		then
			mklibs_optimize_image_doit
			break
		fi
	done
}

mklibs_optimize_image_doit() {
	rm -rf /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/mklibs
	mkdir -p /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/mklibs/dest
	cd /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs
	du -bs > /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/mklibs/du.before.mklibs.txt

	# Build a list of dynamically linked executable ELF files.
	# Omit libc/libpthread as a special case because it has an interpreter
	# but is primarily what we intend to strip down.
	for i in `find . -type f -executable ! -name 'libc-*' ! -name 'libpthread-*'`; do
		file $i | grep -q ELF || continue
		arm-poky-linux-gnueabi-readelf -l $i | grep -q INTERP || continue
		echo $i
	done > /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/mklibs/executables.list

	dynamic_loader=/lib/ld-linux-armhf.so.3

	mklibs -v \
		--ldlib ${dynamic_loader} \
		--libdir lib \
		--sysroot /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/recipe-sysroot \
		--gcc-options "--sysroot=/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/recipe-sysroot" \
		--root /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs \
		--target `echo arm-poky-linux-gnueabi- | sed 's/-$//' ` \
		-d /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/mklibs/dest \
		`cat /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/mklibs/executables.list`

	cd /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/mklibs/dest
	for i in *
	do
		cp $i `find /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs -name $i`
	done

	cd /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs
	du -bs > /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/mklibs/du.after.mklibs.txt

	echo rootfs size before mklibs optimization: `cat /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/mklibs/du.before.mklibs.txt`
	echo rootfs size after mklibs optimization: `cat /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/mklibs/du.after.mklibs.txt`
}

multiubi_mkfs() {
	local mkubifs_args="$1"
	local ubinize_args="$2"

        # Added prompt error message for ubi and ubifs image creation.
        if [ -z "$mkubifs_args" ] || [ -z "$ubinize_args" ]; then
            bbfatal "MKUBIFS_ARGS and UBINIZE_ARGS have to be set, see http://www.linux-mtd.infradead.org/faq/ubifs.html for details"
        fi

	if [ -z "$3" ]; then
		local vname=""
	else
		local vname="_$3"
	fi

	echo \[ubifs\] > ubinize${vname}-custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.cfg
	echo mode=ubi >> ubinize${vname}-custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.cfg
	echo image=/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229${vname}.rootfs.ubifs >> ubinize${vname}-custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.cfg
	echo vol_id=0 >> ubinize${vname}-custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.cfg
	echo vol_type=dynamic >> ubinize${vname}-custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.cfg
	echo vol_name=rootfs >> ubinize${vname}-custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.cfg
	echo vol_flags=autoresize >> ubinize${vname}-custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.cfg
	if [ -n "$vname" ]; then
		mkfs.ubifs -r /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs -o /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229${vname}.rootfs.ubifs ${mkubifs_args}
	fi
	ubinize -o /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229${vname}.rootfs.ubi ${ubinize_args} ubinize${vname}-custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.cfg

	# Cleanup cfg file
	mv ubinize${vname}-custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.cfg /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/

	# Create own symlinks for 'named' volumes
	if [ -n "$vname" ]; then
		cd /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete
		if [ -e custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229${vname}.rootfs.ubifs ]; then
			ln -sf custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229${vname}.rootfs.ubifs \
			custom-image-stm32mp1${vname}.ubifs
		fi
		if [ -e custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229${vname}.rootfs.ubi ]; then
			ln -sf custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229${vname}.rootfs.ubi \
			custom-image-stm32mp1${vname}.ubi
		fi
		cd -
	fi
}

oe_libinstall() {
	# Purpose: Install a library, in all its forms
	# Example
	#
	# oe_libinstall libltdl /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/recipe-sysroot/usr/lib/
	# oe_libinstall -C src/libblah libblah /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/image//usr/lib/
	dir=""
	libtool=""
	silent=""
	require_static=""
	require_shared=""
	staging_install=""
	while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
		case "$1" in
		-C)
			shift
			dir="$1"
			;;
		-s)
			silent=1
			;;
		-a)
			require_static=1
			;;
		-so)
			require_shared=1
			;;
		-*)
			bbfatal "oe_libinstall: unknown option: $1"
			;;
		*)
			break;
			;;
		esac
		shift
	done

	libname="$1"
	shift
	destpath="$1"
	if [ -z "$destpath" ]; then
		bbfatal "oe_libinstall: no destination path specified"
	fi
	if echo "$destpath/" | egrep '^/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/recipe-sysroot/usr/lib/' >/dev/null
	then
		staging_install=1
	fi

	__runcmd () {
		if [ -z "$silent" ]; then
			echo >&2 "oe_libinstall: $*"
		fi
		$*
	}

	if [ -z "$dir" ]; then
		dir=`pwd`
	fi

	dotlai=$libname.lai

	# Sanity check that the libname.lai is unique
	number_of_files=`(cd $dir; find . -name "$dotlai") | wc -l`
	if [ $number_of_files -gt 1 ]; then
		bbfatal "oe_libinstall: $dotlai is not unique in $dir"
	fi


	dir=$dir`(cd $dir;find . -name "$dotlai") | sed "s/^\.//;s/\/$dotlai\$//;q"`
	olddir=`pwd`
	__runcmd cd $dir

	lafile=$libname.la

	# If such file doesn't exist, try to cut version suffix
	if [ ! -f "$lafile" ]; then
		libname1=`echo "$libname" | sed 's/-[0-9.]*$//'`
		lafile1=$libname.la
		if [ -f "$lafile1" ]; then
			libname=$libname1
			lafile=$lafile1
		fi
	fi

	if [ -f "$lafile" ]; then
		# libtool archive
		eval `cat $lafile|grep "^library_names="`
		libtool=1
	else
		library_names="$libname.so* $libname.dll.a $libname.*.dylib"
	fi

	__runcmd install -d $destpath/
	dota=$libname.a
	if [ -f "$dota" -o -n "$require_static" ]; then
		rm -f $destpath/$dota
		__runcmd install -m 0644 $dota $destpath/
	fi
	if [ -f "$dotlai" -a -n "$libtool" ]; then
		rm -f $destpath/$libname.la
		__runcmd install -m 0644 $dotlai $destpath/$libname.la
	fi

	for name in $library_names; do
		files=`eval echo $name`
		for f in $files; do
			if [ ! -e "$f" ]; then
				if [ -n "$libtool" ]; then
					bbfatal "oe_libinstall: $dir/$f not found."
				fi
			elif [ -L "$f" ]; then
				__runcmd cp -P "$f" $destpath/
			elif [ ! -L "$f" ]; then
				libfile="$f"
				rm -f $destpath/$libfile
				__runcmd install -m 0755 $libfile $destpath/
			fi
		done
	done

	if [ -z "$libfile" ]; then
		if  [ -n "$require_shared" ]; then
			bbfatal "oe_libinstall: unable to locate shared library"
		fi
	elif [ -z "$libtool" ]; then
		# special case hack for non-libtool .so.#.#.# links
		baselibfile=`basename "$libfile"`
		if (echo $baselibfile | grep -qE '^lib.*\.so\.[0-9.]*$'); then
			sonamelink=`arm-poky-linux-gnueabi-readelf -d $libfile |grep 'Library soname:' |sed -e 's/.*\[\(.*\)\].*/\1/'`
			solink=`echo $baselibfile | sed -e 's/\.so\..*/.so/'`
			if [ -n "$sonamelink" -a x"$baselibfile" != x"$sonamelink" ]; then
				__runcmd ln -sf $baselibfile $destpath/$sonamelink
			fi
			__runcmd ln -sf $baselibfile $destpath/$solink
		fi
	fi

	__runcmd cd "$olddir"
}

oe_machinstall() {
	# Purpose: Install machine dependent files, if available
	#          If not available, check if there is a default
	#          If no default, just touch the destination
	# Example:
	#                $1  $2   $3         $4
	# oe_machinstall -m 0644 fstab /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/image/etc/fstab
	#
	# TODO: Check argument number?
	#
	filename=`basename $3`
	dirname=`dirname $3`

	for o in `echo linux-gnueabi:arm:pn-custom-image:armv7ve:stm32mp1:stcommon:stm32mpcommon:stm32mp1common:poky:class-target:libc-glibc:forcevariable | tr ':' ' '`; do
		if [ -e $dirname/$o/$filename ]; then
			bbnote $dirname/$o/$filename present, installing to $4
			install $1 $2 $dirname/$o/$filename $4
			return
		fi
	done
#	bbnote overrides specific file NOT present, trying default=$3...
	if [ -e $3 ]; then
		bbnote $3 present, installing to $4
		install $1 $2 $3 $4
	else
		bbnote $3 NOT present, touching empty $4
		touch $4
	fi
}

oe_mkext234fs() {
	fstype=$1
	extra_imagecmd=""

	if [ $# -gt 1 ]; then
		shift
		extra_imagecmd=$@
	fi

	# If generating an empty image the size of the sparse block should be large
	# enough to allocate an ext4 filesystem using 4096 bytes per inode, this is
	# about 60K, so dd needs a minimum count of 60, with bs=1024 (bytes per IO)
	eval local COUNT=\"0\"
	eval local MIN_COUNT=\"60\"
	if [ $ROOTFS_SIZE -lt $MIN_COUNT ]; then
		eval COUNT=\"$MIN_COUNT\"
	fi
	# Create a sparse image block
	bbdebug 1 Executing "dd if=/dev/zero of=/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.rootfs.$fstype seek=$ROOTFS_SIZE count=$COUNT bs=1024"
	dd if=/dev/zero of=/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.rootfs.$fstype seek=$ROOTFS_SIZE count=$COUNT bs=1024
	bbdebug 1 "Actual Rootfs size:  `du -s /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs`"
	bbdebug 1 "Actual Partion size: `stat -c '%s' /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.rootfs.$fstype`"
	bbdebug 1 Executing "mkfs.$fstype -F $extra_imagecmd /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.rootfs.$fstype -d /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs"
	mkfs.$fstype -F $extra_imagecmd /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.rootfs.$fstype -d /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs
	# Error codes 0-3 indicate successfull operation of fsck (no errors or errors corrected)
	fsck.$fstype -pvfD /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229.rootfs.$fstype || [ $? -le 3 ]
}

oe_runmake() {
	oe_runmake_call "$@" || die "oe_runmake failed"
}

oe_runmake_call() {
	bbnote make  "$@"
	make  "$@"
}

oe_soinstall() {
	# Purpose: Install shared library file and
	#          create the necessary links
	# Example: oe_soinstall libfoo.so.1.2.3 /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/image/usr/lib
	libname=`basename $1`
	case "$libname" in
	    *.so)
	        bbfatal "oe_soinstall: Shared library must haved versioned filename (e.g. libfoo.so.1.2.3)"
	        ;;
	esac
	install -m 755 $1 $2/$libname
	sonamelink=`arm-poky-linux-gnueabi-readelf -d $1 |grep 'Library soname:' |sed -e 's/.*\[\(.*\)\].*/\1/'`
	if [ -z $sonamelink ]; then
		bbfatal "oe_soinstall: $libname is missing ELF tag 'SONAME'."
	fi
	solink=`echo $libname | sed -e 's/\.so\..*/.so/'`
	ln -sf $libname $2/$sonamelink
	ln -sf $libname $2/$solink
}

packagedata_translate_pr_autoinc() {
    find /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/pkgdata-pdata-input -type f | xargs --no-run-if-empty \
        sed -e 's,@PRSERV_PV_AUTOINC@,AUTOINC,g' \
            -e 's,@EXTENDPRAUTO@,,g' -i
}

perform_groupadd() {
	local rootdir="$1"
	local opts="$2"
	bbnote "custom-image: Performing groupadd with [$opts]"
	local groupname=`echo "$opts" | awk '{ print $NF }'`
	local group_exists="`grep "^$groupname:" $rootdir/etc/group || true`"
	if test "x$group_exists" = "x"; then
		eval flock -x $rootdir/etc -c \"$PSEUDO groupadd \$opts\" || true
		group_exists="`grep "^$groupname:" $rootdir/etc/group || true`"
		if test "x$group_exists" = "x"; then
			bbfatal "custom-image: groupadd command did not succeed."
		fi
	else
		bbnote "custom-image: group $groupname already exists, not re-creating it"
	fi
}

perform_groupdel() {
	local rootdir="$1"
	local opts="$2"
	bbnote "custom-image: Performing groupdel with [$opts]"
	local groupname=`echo "$opts" | awk '{ print $NF }'`
	local group_exists="`grep "^$groupname:" $rootdir/etc/group || true`"

	if test "x$group_exists" != "x"; then
		local awk_input='BEGIN {FS=":"}; $1=="'$groupname'" { print $3 }'
		local groupid=`echo "$awk_input" | awk -f- $rootdir/etc/group`
		local awk_check_users='BEGIN {FS=":"}; $4=="'$groupid'" {print $1}'
		local other_users=`echo "$awk_check_users" | awk -f- $rootdir/etc/passwd`

		if test "x$other_users" = "x"; then
			eval flock -x $rootdir/etc -c \"$PSEUDO groupdel \$opts\" || true
			group_exists="`grep "^$groupname:" $rootdir/etc/group || true`"
			if test "x$group_exists" != "x"; then
				bbfatal "custom-image: groupdel command did not succeed."
			fi
		else
			bbnote "custom-image: '$groupname' is primary group for users '$other_users', not removing it"
		fi
	else
		bbnote "custom-image: group $groupname doesn't exist, not removing it"
	fi
}

perform_groupmems() {
	local rootdir="$1"
	local opts="$2"
	bbnote "custom-image: Performing groupmems with [$opts]"
	local groupname=`echo "$opts" | awk '{ for (i = 1; i < NF; i++) if ($i == "-g" || $i == "--group") print $(i+1) }'`
	local username=`echo "$opts" | awk '{ for (i = 1; i < NF; i++) if ($i == "-a" || $i == "--add") print $(i+1) }'`
	bbnote "custom-image: Running groupmems command with group $groupname and user $username"
	local mem_exists="`grep "^$groupname:[^:]*:[^:]*:\([^,]*,\)*$username\(,[^,]*\)*$" $rootdir/etc/group || true`"
	if test "x$mem_exists" = "x"; then
		eval flock -x $rootdir/etc -c \"$PSEUDO groupmems \$opts\" || true
		mem_exists="`grep "^$groupname:[^:]*:[^:]*:\([^,]*,\)*$username\(,[^,]*\)*$" $rootdir/etc/group || true`"
		if test "x$mem_exists" = "x"; then
			bbfatal "custom-image: groupmems command did not succeed."
		fi
	else
		bbnote "custom-image: group $groupname already contains $username, not re-adding it"
	fi
}

perform_groupmod() {
	# Other than the return value of groupmod, there's no simple way to judge whether the command
	# succeeds, so we disable -e option temporarily
	set +e
	local rootdir="$1"
	local opts="$2"
	bbnote "custom-image: Performing groupmod with [$opts]"
	local groupname=`echo "$opts" | awk '{ print $NF }'`
	local group_exists="`grep "^$groupname:" $rootdir/etc/group || true`"
	if test "x$group_exists" != "x"; then
		eval flock -x $rootdir/etc -c \"$PSEUDO groupmod \$opts\"
		if test $? != 0; then
			bbwarn "custom-image: groupmod command did not succeed."
		fi
	else
		bbwarn "custom-image: group $groupname doesn't exist, unable to modify it"
	fi
	set -e
}

perform_useradd() {
	local rootdir="$1"
	local opts="$2"
	bbnote "custom-image: Performing useradd with [$opts]"
	local username=`echo "$opts" | awk '{ print $NF }'`
	local user_exists="`grep "^$username:" $rootdir/etc/passwd || true`"
	if test "x$user_exists" = "x"; then
		eval flock -x $rootdir/etc -c  \"$PSEUDO useradd \$opts\" || true
		user_exists="`grep "^$username:" $rootdir/etc/passwd || true`"
		if test "x$user_exists" = "x"; then
			bbfatal "custom-image: useradd command did not succeed."
		fi
	else
		bbnote "custom-image: user $username already exists, not re-creating it"
	fi
}

			rpm_log_check $target $lf_path
		else

		fi

	done
}

prelink_image() {
#	export PSEUDO_DEBUG=4
#	/bin/env | /bin/grep PSEUDO
#	echo "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$LD_LIBRARY_PATH"
#	echo "LD_PRELOAD=$LD_PRELOAD"

	pre_prelink_size=`du -ks /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs | awk '{size = $1 ; print size }'`
	echo "Size before prelinking $pre_prelink_size."

	# The filesystem may not contain sysconfdir so establish what is present
	# to enable cleanup after temporary creation of sysconfdir if needed
	presentdir="/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc"
	while [ "/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs" != "${presentdir}" ] ; do
		[ ! -d "${presentdir}" ] || break
		presentdir=`dirname "${presentdir}"`
	done

	mkdir -p "/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc"

	# We need a prelink conf on the filesystem, add one if it's missing
	if [ ! -e /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/prelink.conf ]; then
		cp /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/recipe-sysroot-native/etc/prelink.conf \
			/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/prelink.conf
		dummy_prelink_conf=true;
	else
		dummy_prelink_conf=false;
	fi

	# We need a ld.so.conf with pathnames in,prelink conf on the filesystem, add one if it's missing
	ldsoconf=/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/ld.so.conf
	if [ -e $ldsoconf ]; then
		cp $ldsoconf $ldsoconf.prelink
	fi
	cat /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/recipe-sysroot/etc/ld.so.conf >> $ldsoconf

	dynamic_loader=/lib/ld-linux-armhf.so.3

	# prelink!
	if [ "1" = "1" ]; then
		bbnote " prelink: BUILD_REPRODUCIBLE_BINARIES..."
		if [ "$REPRODUCIBLE_TIMESTAMP_ROOTFS" = "" ]; then
			export PRELINK_TIMESTAMP=`git log -1 --pretty=%ct `
		else
			export PRELINK_TIMESTAMP=$REPRODUCIBLE_TIMESTAMP_ROOTFS
		fi
		/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/recipe-sysroot-native/usr/sbin/prelink --root /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs -am -N -c /etc/prelink.conf --dynamic-linker $dynamic_loader
	else
		/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/recipe-sysroot-native/usr/sbin/prelink --root /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs -amR -N -c /etc/prelink.conf --dynamic-linker $dynamic_loader
	fi

	# Remove the prelink.conf if we had to add it.
	if [ "$dummy_prelink_conf" = "true" ]; then
		rm -f /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/prelink.conf
	fi

	if [ -e $ldsoconf.prelink ]; then
		mv $ldsoconf.prelink $ldsoconf
	else
		rm $ldsoconf
	fi

	# Remove any directories temporarily created for sysconfdir
	cleanupdir="/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc"
	while [ "${presentdir}" != "${cleanupdir}" ] ; do
		rmdir "${cleanupdir}"
		cleanupdir=`dirname ${cleanupdir}`
	done

	pre_prelink_size=`du -ks /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs | awk '{size = $1 ; print size }'`
	echo "Size after prelinking $pre_prelink_size."
}

read_only_rootfs_hook() {
	# Tweak the mount option and fs_passno for rootfs in fstab
	if [ -f /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/fstab ]; then
		sed -i -e '/^[#[:space:]]*\/dev\/root/{s/defaults/ro/;s/\([[:space:]]*[[:digit:]]\)\([[:space:]]*\)[[:digit:]]$/\1\20/}' /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/fstab
	fi

	# Tweak the "mount -o remount,rw /" command in busybox-inittab inittab
	if [ -f /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/inittab ]; then
		sed -i 's|/bin/mount -o remount,rw /|/bin/mount -o remount,ro /|' /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/inittab
	fi

	# If we're using openssh and the /etc/ssh directory has no pre-generated keys,
	# we should configure openssh to use the configuration file /etc/ssh/sshd_config_readonly
	# and the keys under /var/run/ssh.
	if [ -d /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/ssh ]; then
		if [ -e /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/ssh/ssh_host_rsa_key ]; then
			echo "SYSCONFDIR=\${SYSCONFDIR:-/etc/ssh}" >> /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/default/ssh
			echo "SSHD_OPTS=" >> /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/default/ssh
		else
			echo "SYSCONFDIR=\${SYSCONFDIR:-/var/run/ssh}" >> /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/default/ssh
			echo "SSHD_OPTS='-f /etc/ssh/sshd_config_readonly'" >> /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/default/ssh
		fi
	fi

	# Also tweak the key location for dropbear in the same way.
	if [ -d /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/dropbear ]; then
		if [ ! -e /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/dropbear/dropbear_rsa_host_key ]; then
			echo "DROPBEAR_RSAKEY_DIR=/var/lib/dropbear" >> /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/default/dropbear
		fi
	fi

	if true; then
		# Change the value of ROOTFS_READ_ONLY in /etc/default/rcS to yes
		if [ -e /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/default/rcS ]; then
			sed -i 's/ROOTFS_READ_ONLY=no/ROOTFS_READ_ONLY=yes/' /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/default/rcS
		fi
		# Run populate-volatile.sh at rootfs time to set up basic files
		# and directories to support read-only rootfs.
		if [ -x /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/init.d/populate-volatile.sh ]; then
			/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/init.d/populate-volatile.sh
		fi
	fi

	if false; then
	# Create machine-id
	# 20:12 < mezcalero> koen: you have three options: a) run systemd-machine-id-setup at install time, b) have / read-only and an empty file there (for stateless) and c) boot with / writable
		touch /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/machine-id
	fi
}

	fi
}

    if [ "1" = "1" ]; then

            fi
        fi
        # Set mtime of all files to a reproducible value

        find  /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs -print0 | xargs -0 touch -h  --date=@$REPRODUCIBLE_TIMESTAMP_ROOTFS
    fi
}

rootfs_check_host_user_contaminated() {
	contaminated="/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/host-user-contaminated.txt"
	HOST_USER_UID="$(PSEUDO_UNLOAD=1 id -u)"
	HOST_USER_GID="$(PSEUDO_UNLOAD=1 id -g)"

	find "/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs" -path "/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/home" -prune -o \
	    -user "$HOST_USER_UID" -print -o -group "$HOST_USER_GID" -print >"$contaminated"

	sed -e "s,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs,," $contaminated | while read line; do
		bbwarn "Path in the rootfs is owned by the same user or group as the user running bitbake:" $line `ls -lan /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/$line`
	done

	if [ -s "$contaminated" ]; then
		bbwarn "/etc/passwd:" `cat /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/passwd`
		bbwarn "/etc/group:" `cat /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/group`
	fi
}

sdk_ext_postinst() {
	printf "\nExtracting buildtools...\n"
	cd $target_sdk_dir
	env_setup_script="$target_sdk_dir/environment-setup-cortexa7t2hf-neon-vfpv4-poky-linux-gnueabi"
        if [ -n "${SDK_BUILDTOOLS_INSTALLER}" ]; then
		printf "buildtools\ny" | ./${SDK_BUILDTOOLS_INSTALLER} > buildtools.log || { printf 'ERROR: buildtools installation failed:\n' ; cat buildtools.log ; echo "printf 'ERROR: this SDK was not fully installed and needs reinstalling\n'" >> $env_setup_script ; exit 1 ; }

		# Delete the buildtools tar file since it won't be used again
		rm -f ./${SDK_BUILDTOOLS_INSTALLER}
		# We don't need the log either since it succeeded
		rm -f buildtools.log

		# Make sure when the user sets up the environment, they also get
		# the buildtools-tarball tools in their path.
		echo ". $target_sdk_dir/buildtools/environment-setup*" >> $env_setup_script
	fi

	# Allow bitbake environment setup to be ran as part of this sdk.
	echo "export OE_SKIP_SDK_CHECK=1" >> $env_setup_script
	# Work around runqemu not knowing how to get this information within the eSDK
	echo "export DEPLOY_DIR_IMAGE=$target_sdk_dir/tmp/deploy/images/stm32mp1" >> $env_setup_script

	# A bit of another hack, but we need this in the path only for devtool
	# so put it at the end of $PATH.
	echo "export PATH=$target_sdk_dir/sysroots/x86_64-pokysdk-linux/usr/bin:\$PATH" >> $env_setup_script

	echo "printf 'SDK environment now set up; additionally you may now run devtool to perform development tasks.\nRun devtool --help for further details.\n'" >> $env_setup_script

	# Warn if trying to use external bitbake and the ext SDK together
	echo "(which bitbake > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'WARNING: attempting to use the extensible SDK in an environment set up to run bitbake - this may lead to unexpected results. Please source this script in a new shell session instead.') || true" >> $env_setup_script

	if [ "$prepare_buildsystem" != "no" -a -n "${SDK_BUILDTOOLS_INSTALLER}" ]; then
		printf "Preparing build system...\n"
		# dash which is /bin/sh on Ubuntu will not preserve the
		# current working directory when first ran, nor will it set $1 when
		# sourcing a script. That is why this has to look so ugly.
		LOGFILE="$target_sdk_dir/preparing_build_system.log"
		sh -c ". buildtools/environment-setup* > $LOGFILE && cd $target_sdk_dir/`dirname ${oe_init_build_env_path}` && set $target_sdk_dir && . $target_sdk_dir/${oe_init_build_env_path} $target_sdk_dir >> $LOGFILE && python3 $target_sdk_dir/ext-sdk-prepare.py $LOGFILE ''" || { echo "printf 'ERROR: this SDK was not fully installed and needs reinstalling\n'" >> $env_setup_script ; exit 1 ; }
	fi
	if [ -e $target_sdk_dir/ext-sdk-prepare.py ]; then
		rm $target_sdk_dir/ext-sdk-prepare.py
	fi
	echo done
}

sdk_ext_preinst() {
	# Since bitbake won't run as root it doesn't make sense to try and install
	# the extensible sdk as root.
	if [ "`id -u`" = "0" ]; then
		echo "ERROR: The extensible sdk cannot be installed as root."
		exit 1
	fi
	if ! command -v locale > /dev/null; then
		echo "ERROR: The installer requires the locale command, please install it first"
		exit 1
	fi
        # Check setting of LC_ALL set above
	canonicalised_locale=`echo $LC_ALL | sed 's/UTF-8/utf8/'`
	if ! locale -a | grep -q $canonicalised_locale ; then
		echo "ERROR: the installer requires the $LC_ALL locale to be installed (but not selected), please install it first"
		exit 1
	fi
	# The relocation script used by buildtools installer requires python
	if ! command -v python3 > /dev/null; then
		echo "ERROR: The installer requires python3, please install it first"
		exit 1
	fi
	missing_utils=""
	for util in ${SDK_REQUIRED_UTILITIES}; do
		if ! command -v $util > /dev/null; then
			missing_utils="$missing_utils $util"
		fi
	done
	if [ -n "$missing_utils" ] ; then
		echo "ERROR: the SDK requires the following missing utilities, please install them: $missing_utils"
		exit 1
	fi
	SDK_EXTENSIBLE="1"
	if [ "$publish" = "1" ] && [ "full" = "minimal" ] ; then
		EXTRA_TAR_OPTIONS="$EXTRA_TAR_OPTIONS --exclude=sstate-cache"
	fi
}

set_user_group() {
	user_group_settings="	usermod -P 'toor' root 	"
	export PSEUDO="PSEUDO_PREFIX=/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/sysroots-components/x86_64/pseudo-native/usr PSEUDO_LOCALSTATEDIR=/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/pseudo/ PSEUDO_PASSWD=/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs:/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/recipe-sysroot-native PSEUDO_NOSYMLINKEXP=1 PSEUDO_IGNORE_PATHS=/usr/,/etc/,/usr/lib,/dev/,/run/,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/temp,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/recipe-sysroot,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/stamps,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/sstate-control,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/buildstats,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/sysroots-components,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/pkgdata,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/sstate-build-package_,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/sstate-install-package_,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/pkgdata-sysroot,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/deploy,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/cache,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/poky/scripts,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/poky/meta/files/common-licenses,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/meta-openembedded/meta-oe/licenses,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/meta-openembedded/meta-python/licenses,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/poky/meta/COPYING,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/x86_64-deploy-custom-image-populate-sdk,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/oe-sdk-repo,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/sstate-build-populate_sdk,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/build-wic,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/intercept_scripts,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/oe-rootfs-repo,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/sstate-build-image_complete,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/custom-image-1.0,/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/custom-image-1.0 PSEUDO_DISABLED=0 /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/recipe-sysroot-native/usr/bin/pseudo"
	setting=`echo $user_group_settings | cut -d ';' -f1`
	remaining=`echo $user_group_settings | cut -d ';' -f2-`
	while test "x$setting" != "x"; do
		cmd=`echo $setting | cut -d ' ' -f1`
		opts=`echo $setting | cut -d ' ' -f2-`
		# Different from useradd.bbclass, there's no file locking issue here, as
		# this setting is actually a serial process. So we only retry once.
		case $cmd in
			useradd)
				perform_useradd "/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs" "-R /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs $opts"
				;;
			groupadd)
				perform_groupadd "/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs" "-R /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs $opts"
				;;
			userdel)
				perform_userdel "/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs" "-R /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs $opts"
				;;
			groupdel)
				perform_groupdel "/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs" "-R /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs $opts"
				;;
			usermod)
				perform_usermod "/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs" "-R /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs $opts"
				;;
			groupmod)
				perform_groupmod "/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs" "-R /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs $opts"
				;;
			*)
				bbfatal "Invalid command in EXTRA_USERS_PARAMS: $cmd"
				;;
		esac
		# Avoid infinite loop if the last parameter doesn't end with ';'
		if [ "$setting" = "$remaining" ]; then
			break
		fi
		# iterate to the next setting
		setting=`echo $remaining | cut -d ';' -f1`
		remaining=`echo $remaining | cut -d ';' -f2-`
	done
}

	for config in sshd_config sshd_config_readonly; do
		if [ -e /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/ssh/$config ]; then
			sed -i 's/^[#[:space:]]*PermitEmptyPasswords.*/PermitEmptyPasswords yes/' /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/ssh/$config
		fi
	done

	if [ -e /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/usr/sbin/dropbear ] ; then
		if grep -q DROPBEAR_EXTRA_ARGS /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/default/dropbear 2>/dev/null ; then
			if ! grep -q "DROPBEAR_EXTRA_ARGS=.*-B" /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/default/dropbear ; then
				sed -i 's/^DROPBEAR_EXTRA_ARGS="*\([^"]*\)"*/DROPBEAR_EXTRA_ARGS="\1 -B"/' /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/default/dropbear
			fi
		else
			printf '\nDROPBEAR_EXTRA_ARGS="-B"\n' >> /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/default/dropbear
		fi
	fi

	if [ -d /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/pam.d ] ; then

			sed -i 's/nullok_secure/nullok/' $f
		done
	fi
}

sstate_create_package() {
	# Exit early if it already exists
	if [ -e /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/ ]; then
		[ ! -w /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/ ] || touch /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/
		return
	fi

	mkdir -p `dirname /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/`
	TFILE=`mktemp /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/.XXXXXXXX`

	# Use pigz if available
	OPT="-czS"
	if [ -x "$(command -v pigz)" ]; then
		OPT="-I pigz -cS"
	fi

	# Need to handle empty directories
	if [ "$(ls -A)" ]; then
		set +e
		tar $OPT -f $TFILE *
		ret=$?
		if [ $ret -ne 0 ] && [ $ret -ne 1 ]; then
			exit 1
		fi
		set -e
	else
		tar $OPT --file=$TFILE --files-from=/dev/null
	fi
	chmod 0664 $TFILE
	# Skip if it was already created by some other process
	if [ ! -e /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/ ]; then
		# Move into place using ln to attempt an atomic op.
		# Abort if it already exists
		ln $TFILE /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/ && rm $TFILE
	else
		rm $TFILE
	fi
	[ ! -w /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/ ] || touch /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/
}

sstate_unpack_package() {
	tar -xvzf /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/
	# update .siginfo atime on local/NFS mirror
	[ -O /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/.siginfo ] && [ -w /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/.siginfo ] && [ -h /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/.siginfo ] && touch -a /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/.siginfo
	# Use "! -w ||" to return true for read only files
	[ ! -w /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/ ] || touch --no-dereference /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/
	[ ! -w /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/.sig ] || [ ! -e /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/.sig ] || touch --no-dereference /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/.sig
	[ ! -w /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/.siginfo ] || [ ! -e /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/.siginfo ] || touch --no-dereference /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/sstate-cache/.siginfo
}

st_multivolume_ubifs() {
    if [ "1" != "1" ]; then
        return
    fi
    if [ -n "uboot_config:256:empty uboot_config_r:256:empty  st-image-bootfs:65536 st-image-vendorfs:16384 custom-image:763904 st-image-userfs:131072" ]; then
        . /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/temp/stmultiubi_environment

        # Get total volume number to handle
        volume_nbr="$(echo uboot_config:256:empty uboot_config_r:256:empty  st-image-bootfs:65536 st-image-vendorfs:16384 custom-image:763904 st-image-userfs:131072 | wc -w)"

        for name in  nand_4_256; do
            # Init extra_size for UBIFS volume size
            eval local extra_size=\"\$EXTRA_UBIFS_SIZE_${name}\"
            # Init var to populate 'vol_id' incrementally
            volume_id=0
            for ubivolume in uboot_config:256:empty uboot_config_r:256:empty  st-image-bootfs:65536 st-image-vendorfs:16384 custom-image:763904 st-image-userfs:131072; do
                # Init UBI volume information
                if [ -z "$(echo ${ubivolume} | grep ':')" ]; then
                    bbfatal "Missing ':' separator between UBI volume name and UBI volume size '${ubivolume}'"
                fi
                volume_name=$(echo ${ubivolume} | cut -d':' -f1)
                volume_size=$(echo ${ubivolume} | cut -d':' -f2)
                volume_type=$(echo ${ubivolume} | cut -d':' -f3)
                bbnote "Original UBI volume size: ${volume_size}"
                # Manage specific UBI volume type
                if [ "${volume_type}" = "empty" ]; then
                    bbnote "The UBI volume type is set to 'empty' for ${volume_name}. Generate ubinize cfg file for empty UBI volume."
                    cfg_filename=/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/${volume_name}_${name}.ubinize.cfg.ubi
                    echo \[${volume_name}\] > ${cfg_filename}
                    echo mode=ubi >> ${cfg_filename}
                    echo vol_id=0 >> ${cfg_filename}
                    echo vol_type=dynamic >> ${cfg_filename}
                    echo vol_name=${volume_name} >> ${cfg_filename}
                    echo vol_flags=autoresize >> ${cfg_filename}
                else
                    # Update volume_name to fit image link name scheme
                    if [ "${volume_name}" = "custom-image" ]; then
                        volume_name=custom-image-stm32mp1
                    else
                        # Partiton images use case, so make sure to append DISTRO and MACHINE
                        volume_name=${volume_name}-poky-stm32mp1
                    fi
                    if [ -z "${volume_type}" ]; then
                        bbnote "The UBI volume type is not set. Use default configuration for ${volume_name}"
                        bbnote "Append ${extra_size}KiB extra space to UBIFS volume size"
                        volume_size=$(echo "${volume_size} + ${extra_size}" | bc)
                    else
                        bbwarn "The UBI volume type '${volume_type}' is not recognized. No specific action done for ${volume_name}"
                    fi
                fi
                bbnote "Computed UBI volume size: ${volume_size}"
                # Set ubinize config file for current volume
                if [ -e /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/${volume_name}_${name}.ubinize.cfg.ubi ]; then
                    ubinize_cfg=/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/${volume_name}_${name}.ubinize.cfg.ubi
                elif [ -e /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/deploy/images/stm32mp1/${volume_name}_${name}.ubinize.cfg.ubi ]; then
                    ubinize_cfg=/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/deploy/images/stm32mp1/${volume_name}_${name}.ubinize.cfg.ubi
                else
                    bbfatal "Can't find any '${volume_name}_${name}.ubinize.cfg.ubi' config file from /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete or /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/deploy/images/stm32mp1 folders"
                fi
                # Create temporary copy of ubinize config file for update
                cp ${ubinize_cfg} /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/
                # Update ubifs path in cfg file with DEPLOY_DIR_IMAGE to avoid issue with RM_WORK feature
                if [ -e /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/deploy/images/stm32mp1/${volume_name}_${name}.ubinize.cfg.ubi ]; then
                    sed 's|^image=.*/\('"${volume_name}"'.*\.ubifs\)$|image='"/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/deploy/images/stm32mp1"'/\1|' -i /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/$(basename ${ubinize_cfg})
                fi
                # Update generic name in cfg file
                sed 's|\[ubifs\]|\['"${volume_name}"'\]|' -i /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/$(basename ${ubinize_cfg})
                # Update volume id in cfg file
                sed 's|vol_id=0|vol_id='"${volume_id}"'|' -i /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/$(basename ${ubinize_cfg})
                volume_id=$(expr ${volume_id} + 1)
                # Replace 'vol_flags' entry with 'vol_size' one in cfg file except for last volume to allow proper autoresize
                if [ "${volume_id}" -lt "${volume_nbr}" ]; then
                    sed 's|vol_flags=.*|vol_size='"${volume_size}KiB"'|' -i /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/$(basename ${ubinize_cfg})
                fi
                # Increment volume id for next loop
                # Append ubinize config file to multivolume one
                cat /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/$(basename ${ubinize_cfg}) >> /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229_${name}_multivolume.ubinize.cfg.ubi
                # Clean temporary file
                rm -f /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/$(basename ${ubinize_cfg})
                # Clean also temporary ubinize cfg file for empty UBI volume
                [ "${volume_type}" = "empty" ] && rm -f ${cfg_filename}
            done

            # Generate multivolume UBI
            eval local ubinize_args=\"\$UBINIZE_ARGS_${name}\"
            ubinize -o /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229_${name}_multivolume.rootfs.ubi ${ubinize_args} /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete/custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229_${name}_multivolume.ubinize.cfg.ubi

            # Create own symlinks for 'named' volumes
            cd /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/deploy-custom-image-image-complete
            if [ -e custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229_${name}_multivolume.rootfs.ubi ]; then
                ln -sf custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229_${name}_multivolume.rootfs.ubi custom-image-stm32mp1_${name}_multivolume.ubi
                ln -sf custom-image-stm32mp1-20230423233229_${name}_multivolume.ubinize.cfg.ubi custom-image-stm32mp1_${name}_multivolume.ubinize.cfg.ubi
            fi
            cd -

            # Cleanup also DEPLOY_DIR_IMAGE from any other ubi artifacts
            # This avoid duplicating data in DEPLOY_DIR_IMAGE
            rm -f /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/deploy/images/stm32mp1/custom-image-stm32mp1-*_${name}_multivolume.rootfs.ubi
            rm -f /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/deploy/images/stm32mp1/custom-image-stm32mp1-*_${name}_multivolume.ubinize.cfg.ubi
        done
    fi
}

sysroot_stage_all() {
	sysroot_stage_dirs /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/image /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/sysroot-destdir
}

sysroot_stage_dir() {
	src="$1"
	dest="$2"
	# if the src doesn't exist don't do anything
	if [ ! -d "$src" ]; then
		 return
	fi

	mkdir -p "$dest"
	(
		cd $src
		find . -print0 | cpio --null -pdlu $dest
	)
}

sysroot_stage_dirs() {
	from="$1"
	to="$2"

	for dir in      /usr/include     /usr/lib     /lib     /lib     /usr/share ; do
		sysroot_stage_dir "$from$dir" "$to$dir"
	done

	# Remove directories we do not care about
	for dir in      /usr/share/man     /usr/share/doc     /usr/share/info     /usr/share/X11/locale     /usr/share/applications     /usr/share/bash-completion     /usr/share/fonts     /usr/share/gtk-doc/html     /usr/share/installed-tests     /usr/share/locale     /usr/share/pixmaps     /usr/share/terminfo     /usr/lib/custom-image/ptest ; do
		rm -rf "$to$dir"
	done
}

systemd_create_users() {
	for conffile in /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/usr/lib/sysusers.d/systemd.conf /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/usr/lib/sysusers.d/systemd-remote.conf; do
		[ -e $conffile ] || continue
		grep -v "^#" $conffile | sed -e '/^$/d' | while read type name id comment; do
		if [ "$type" = "u" ]; then
			useradd_params="--shell /sbin/nologin"
			[ "$id" != "-" ] && useradd_params="$useradd_params --uid $id"
			[ "$comment" != "-" ] && useradd_params="$useradd_params --comment $comment"
			useradd_params="$useradd_params --system $name"
			eval useradd --root /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs $useradd_params || true
		elif [ "$type" = "g" ]; then
			groupadd_params=""
			[ "$id" != "-" ] && groupadd_params="$groupadd_params --gid $id"
			groupadd_params="$groupadd_params --system $name"
			eval groupadd --root /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs $groupadd_params || true
		elif [ "$type" = "m" ]; then
			group=$id
			if [ ! `grep -q "^${group}:" /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/group` ]; then
				eval groupadd --root /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs --system $group
			fi
			if [ ! `grep -q "^${name}:" /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/passwd` ]; then
				eval useradd --root /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs --shell /sbin/nologin --system $name
			fi
			eval usermod --root /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs -a -G $group $name
		fi
		done
	done
}

systemd_preset_all() {
    if [ -e /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/lib/systemd/systemd ]; then
	systemctl --root="/home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs" --preset-mode=enable-only preset-all
    fi
}

        fi
	if [ -e /home/regan/Projects/yocto/build-mp1/tmp/work/stm32mp1-poky-linux-gnueabi/custom-image/1.0-r0/rootfs/etc/passwd ]; then
